capabilities: Throw 3D dice over notes and read the total
Send roll results to Atlas VTT's dice log and player view
Add, colour, and name dice (d4 to d100)
Reroll dice caught landing on an edge
Install and edit custom dice packs with face art and finishes
disambiguation: Not a virtual tabletop itself; it rolls dice inside Obsidian and feeds results to Atlas VTT when a map is open.
extras: Some features (packs as Atlas dice looks, dice packs tab, collection dice colours) require an Atlas extension API that no released Atlas build has yet; the plugin makes no network requests.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to roll dice for tabletop games or share roll results with a virtual tabletop.

relations.evidence: Every result goes into that map's dice log and shows as Atlas's result card

summary: 3D dice roller that throws physical-style dice over your notes and sends results to Atlas VTT's dice log.
